QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] What Happened to Friendship?
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bEdea#k in the #bDowntown Black Market#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Edea said #rVelderoth#k sent a letter to Kaiser a few days ago for a one-on-one fight, which Kaiser accepted. However, there's a high chance that this is a trap... 

You feel uneasy sending Kaiser alone. Secretly follow Kaiser to #bHeliseum Outskirts#k. 

#r#e*If you fail, forfeit the quest and start over from the beginning.#k
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the Specter forces summoned by Velderoth. He said it would be a one-on-one fight, but it was all a lie. He's no longer the Velderoth that you once knew...
